Spatial cross-validation diagnostics for declared prediction targets

Source: R/spCVAudit-package.R
spCVAudit-package.Rd

Define a target with prediction_target(), construct or import folds with spatial_folds() and cv_folds(), and compare validation conditions with audit_cv() or compare_cv_schemes(). gaussian_cv() implements the known-covariance reference decomposition; it is not a general bias correction.
